title: Safe Checkout Flow Debugging with Direct Bind Standalone
description:
Direct Bind Standalone is a local checkout debugging and status validation tool. It allows developers to safely test payment flows and proxies without exposing sensitive credentials.

Run offline contract testing, manage proxy pools safely, and test 3DS or subscription states entirely on localhost without real transactions.
